description: Deterministic mixed-content streaming response for the UI responsiveness benchmark suite (mitto-sus.1.2). Cycles through fenced code blocks, GFM tables, Mermaid diagrams, absolute URLs, and Beads issue references so a single agent turn exercises all three render post-processors (tables, mermaid, beadsLinks).

chunks:
# Mixed-content benchmark stream

This deterministic response cycles through code, tables, Mermaid, links, and Beads references 6 times to exercise every render post-processor during a single streamed agent turn. See https://example.com/mitto-sus-1-2 for context.

## Cycle 1

Reference issues mitto-sus.1.1 and mitto-sus.1 while reviewing this section.

```javascript
function cycle0() {
  console.log("mixed content cycle 1 of 6");
  return 1;
}
```

|--------|-------|
| cycle | 1 |
| longTasks | 0 |
| domNodes | 1000 |

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Cycle 1 start] --> B{Post-process?}
    B -->|tables| C[Wrap tables]
    B -->|mermaid| D[Render diagram]
    B -->|beadsLinks| E[Linkify refs]
```

See [the benchmarks doc](https://example.com/docs/ui-responsiveness-benchmarks) for how mitto-sus.1.1 fits the overall plan.
